anchor.statement: Proposition 7.2. Fix α ∈ R , a finite set of harmonics 0 < |m| ≤ M, and a label at level i on a common torus H = Y i 0 , with i − i 0 bounded as in Lemma 6.2. For each harmonic, let f m (x ∗ , H) ∈ C3 be a coefficient descending to H, smooth on the fixed enlargement of that label’s rectangles. Assume that it has a fixed closed slow support contained in the label’s slow support, a compact transverse support contained in supp χg , and support in the closed active shell X a ≤ X ≤ X b , with smooth zero extension across all these support boundaries. Assume also that on X a < X < X b and 0 ≤ v ≤ L s , for every fixed multi-index I of derivatives in (R, Z, T, H), |D I f m | ≤ C I ε αS b I ∗ √︁ ζ δ −a IP(v).

correspondence.note: The zero-data solution along the copy path lies in W_α, satisfies (7.5) with the pressure (7.13), keeps n_Φ · t_m = 0, and its pressure gains ε^{1/2}; hypotheses are abstract energy and jet bounds on coefficient and source. Not stated: uniqueness, descent to the common torus H, independence of q∗ from M, α and the stage, and (within the headline closure) the one-sided derivatives at τ = 0.

  (s : NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.StripData (P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane)) (α : ℝ)
  (d : ℕ → NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.LinearData P V H) (g : ℕ → NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.Geometry)

  (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 0 < W n t) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt (W n) (rate n t * W n t) t) →

            (∀ (n : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (d n).coefficient (U ×ˢ Set.univ)) →

                (∀ (n : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (d n).source (U ×ˢ Set.univ)) →
                  (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ s.domain, ((g n).coordinates (copy n) p.2).2 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (L n)) →
                    ∀ {K₀ : ℝ} {q : ℕ},
                      1 ≤ K₀ →
                        (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ μ n) →
                          (∀ (n : ℕ), L n ≤ K₀ * s.slow n) →
                            (∀ (n : ℕ), Real.exp (μ n * L n) ≤ K₀) →

                                    ∀ p ∈ s.domain,

                                        ∀ (x : H),

                                            (rate n v + μ n) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) →

                                      ∃ (C : ℝ),
                                        0 ≤ C ∧

∀ {P : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup P] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ P]
  (t : NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.TangentData P NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space)
  (g : NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.Geometry) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P},
  IsOpen U →
    ∀ (k : NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency),
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.linearData.coefficient (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.linearData.forcingMap (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.source (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
            ∀ (ε frequency : ℝ),
              frequency ≠ 0 →
                ∀ (R F G Φ : P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane → ℝ)
                  (Vr Vθ Vz : P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane → P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane) {p : P},
                  p ∈ U →
                    ∀ (Y : NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane),
                      (g.coordinates k Y).2 ∈ Set.Ioo a b →
                        NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ (p, Y) =
                            t.normal (p, g.coordinates k Y) →
                          t.damping (p, g.coordinates k Y) =
                              ε * frequency ^ 2 * ‖NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.phaseNormal R Vr Vθ Vz Φ (p, Y)‖ ^ 2 →
                            NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.complexify
                                  ((t.action (p, g.coordinates k Y)) (t.linearData.copySolve g hab k (p, Y))) =
                                NavierStokes.LinearWaveResidual.shear R F G Vr
                                  (NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.copyVelocity t g hab k) (p, Y) →
                              NavierStokes.LinearWaveResidual.principal ε frequency R F G Vr Vθ Vz
                                  (fun (x : P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane) =>
                                    (0, NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.slotDirection g))
                                  Φ (NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.copyVelocity t g hab k)
                                  (NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.copyPressure t g hab k frequency) (p, Y) =
                                -NavierStokes.CurlClassBounds.complexify (t.source (p, Y))
